title: PageCommonV2
description: Page body, layout and widgets shared by documents, document templates and page templates

publisherEntityTagsV2.title: Publisher Entity Tags V2
publisherEntityTagsV2.description: A list of strings - metadata tags.

publisherPxV2.title: Publisher Px V2
publisherPxV2.description: Pixels on the page's design canvas (1920 x 1080 for widescreen).

publisherPageProportionV2.title: Publisher Page Proportion V2
publisherPageProportionV2.description: Share of the parent container this node takes, relative to its siblings. Defaults to 1.

publisherColorValueV2.title: Publisher Color Value V2
publisherColorValueV2.description: A theme color reference such as {theme.palette.primary}, or #rgb, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa, or rgb() with 3 or 4 arguments.

publisherImageSourceV2.title: Publisher Image Source V2
publisherImageSourceV2.description: A theme image reference such as {theme.logo}, or an https URL, which may contain text variables.

publisherGapValueV2.title: Publisher Gap Value V2
publisherGapValueV2.description: Space between children, in pixels or as a theme spacing reference.

publisherPaddingValueV2.title: Publisher Padding Value V2
publisherPaddingValueV2.description: Inner spacing, in pixels or as a theme spacing reference.

publisherRadiusValueV2.title: Publisher Radius Value V2
publisherRadiusValueV2.description: Corner radius, in pixels or as a theme corner reference.

publisherTextStyleNameV2.title: Publisher Text Style Name V2
publisherTextStyleNameV2.description: Named text style from the theme.

publisherPageSizeV2.title: Publisher Page Size V2
publisherPageSizeV2.description: The widescreen design canvas is 1920 x 1080 px.

hint.description: Authoring hint shown in the empty widget.

instructions.description: Instructions the takeaway is generated with.

widgets.description: Ids of the widgets on this page the takeaway is generated from.

publisherTitleWidgetV2.title: Publisher Title Widget V2
publisherTitleWidgetV2.description: The page title. At most one per page.

markdown.description: Inline markdown only: strong, emphasis, highlight, strike, links and line breaks.
Full markdown: paragraphs, lists, quotes and headings.

decorative.description: Page furniture such as page numbers: kept out of the accessibility tree, PDF tags and AI context.
A decorative image needs no alt text.

visualization.description: An id of the visualization rendered here.

date.description: An id of the date dataset the document period applies to.

ignore_document_period.description: When true, the document period does not apply here.

filters.description: Filters applied on top of the page and document filters.

items.description: A type-prefixed id, for example label/region.name, dataset/order_date or metric/revenue.

publisherTakeawayWidgetV2.title: Publisher Takeaway Widget V2
publisherTakeawayWidgetV2.description: Generated or written text about the page.

children.description: Nodes laid out along the container's direction. An empty list renders as a spacer.

publisherLayoutNodeV2.title: Publisher Layout Node V2
publisherLayoutNodeV2.description: A row or column container, or a widget.

kind.description: Editor hint. It does not change how the page renders.

notes.description: Markdown speaker notes, never drawn on the page.

layout.description: Root of the page layout tree.

filters.description: Page filters, applied on top of the document filters.
